name: IAM
description: Cloud and identity management service configurations and controls
attack_surface: User roles, access credentials, authentication API routes, and trust relationship policies
common_misconfigurations: Over-permissive permissions assigned to service roles
Missing cross-tenant permission constraints in trust definitions
Inactive users holding API keys with full administration rights
validation_methods: Verify capability to request resources from non-owned tenant identifier
Check policy document configuration via IAM query API endpoints
evidence_requirements: HTTP trace showing unauthorized access to administration APIs
Dump of policy documents confirming missing constraints
false_positive_indicators: System API returning success code but returning empty or mocked datasets
Permissive policies restricted by downstream environment condition keys
reporting_guidance: Focus on privilege escalation and cross-tenant access. Exclude version disclosures or simple key presence without administrative usage.
